name: robots/nimazareian__quadruped-rl-locomotion
title: Unitree Go1 quadruped (MuJoCo torque scene)
intro: Unitree Go1 quadruped (MuJoCo torque scene), adapted from nimazareian/quadruped-rl-locomotion. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
